stemMarkdown: A boat whose speed in still water is 22 km/h rows 96 km downstream and returns to the starting point. If the stream flows at 4 km/h, find the total time taken (in hours). (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Downstream: $\dfrac{96}{26} = 3.6923$ hours. Upstream: $\dfrac{96}{18} = 5.3333$ hours. Total $= 9.0256$ hours.
altSolutionMarkdown: The return trip always takes longer than the outward one, so the round trip is never just twice the still-water time.
